summary: _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 1_ Parties present: For Petitioner: Shri Subrata Ghosal, DVC For Respondents: Shri Anurag Naik, MPPMCL Shri Nishant Grover, BYPL _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 3_ 4. The annual fixed charges determined vide orders dated 23.1.2015 and 9.2.2017 are subject to the final outcome of the Civil Appeals pending before the Hon’ble Supreme Court in relation to the tariff of the generating stations and inter-state transmission systems of the petitioner determined by the Commission in its various other orders for the period 2006-09. 6. In compliance with the directions of the Commission, the petitioner has filed additional information and has served copies on the respondents. The respondents, MPPMCL and BYPL and the Objector, M/s Damodar Valley Power Consumers Association (DVPCA) have filed their replies/objections in the matter. The petitioner has filed its rejoinder/response to the above. Taking into consideration the submissions of the parties and the documents available on record, we proceed to consider the claims of the petitioner in respect of this generating station for determination of tariff for the period 2014-19. _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 7_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 8_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 9_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 11_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 19_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 21_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 22_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 23_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 27_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 28_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 29_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 31_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 33_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 34_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 35_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 37_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 38_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 39_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 41_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 42_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 43_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 44_ _Order in Petition No. 144/GT/2015 Page 45_ _99.
